structure.layout: Full-viewport canvas game: a black textured frame with a painted desert battlefield stage, a bottom-left turn-order portrait queue and active-unit ability icon, a centred collapsed combat-log line, a right-edge vertical button column (music, fast-forward, skip-turn timer, fullscreen) and a bottom-right player stat panel

aesthetics.typography: Play (techno sans-serif) throughout: queue captions, log line and player panel; the floating combat text on the canvas is yellow with a dark outline
aesthetics.typeScale: Small HUD text: 14px captions and panel text, 18px log line, 12px timestamps; little hierarchy beyond colour

notes: This is a game rather than a web page: nearly everything is drawn on one 1440x810 canvas inside a black skull-textured frame. Team colours are blue (#8888ff) for player 1 and red (#ff5555) for player 2, used on portrait outlines, health pills and log names. Status captions use coloured fills: olive for Sickened, dark gold for Protected, slate for Queued. The square HUD buttons on the right look like brown leather or parchment. The combat log is collapsed to its latest line. There is no codebook entry for a game HUD or turn-order queue, so I filed a proposal (game-hud). The live copy restarts the match, so it couldn't be compared state for state.
